name: shop
prompt: `shop_ex@{host}` is getting slower and using more memory; find out why.

name: payments
prompt: `payments_ex@{host}` fails payments now and then. Find out why.

name: cluster
prompt: `ex_a@{host}` is part of a cluster that's getting slower. Find out why.

name: billing
prompt: `billing_ex@{host}` records every charge twice: acme's balance is double what was charged. Find out why.

name: phoenix
prompt: `phoenix_ex@{host}` runs a Phoenix API. Product search (`GET /api/products/search?q=...`) always returns 404 "product not found", but opening a product (`GET /api/products/2`) works. Find out why.

name: native
prompt: `native_erl@{host}` stalls for tens of milliseconds now and then, and the OS says it uses more memory every minute, though erlang:memory() doesn't change. Find out why.

name: ports
prompt: `ports_erl@{host}`'s port count keeps climbing, and one of its connections stops sending now and then. Find out why.

name: orders
prompt: `orders_erl@{host}` loses some of the orders it imports, and payments fail now and then, but its numbers look healthy. Find out why.

name: crash
prompt: `crash_erl` died a minute after it started. It left a crash dump at `{repo}/examples/erlang/dumps/crash_erl.dump`. Find out why it died.

name: locks
prompt: Shoppers on `locks_erl@{host}` say their reservations all time out now, though it worked when it started. Find out why.

name: phoenix_telemetry
prompt: `phoenix_ex@{host}` is a Phoenix API. Tell me what requests it's serving right now, how fast, and whether anything looks wrong.

name: coupons
prompt: Customers of `orders_erl@{host}` say some coupon codes give them no discount, but nothing about coupons is in the logs. Find which codes, and why.

name: sessions
prompt: The memory of `sessions_erl@{host}` keeps growing. Find out why.

name: reports
prompt: `reports_erl@{host}` uses a lot of CPU for what it does: it only adds up the day's sales. Find out where the CPU goes.

name: deploy
prompt: We deployed a fix to `deploy_erl@{host}`: discounts are 10% now, not 5%. Orders still get 5%. Find out why.

name: dist
prompt: The network link between `dist_a@{host}` and `dist_b@{host}` is saturated. Find out what's using it.

name: bandit
prompt: Some clients of `bandit_ex@{host}` get their connections reset, or wait seconds before the first byte, but the request times Bandit reports look fine and nothing is logged. Find out why.

name: riak
prompt: Writes to our riak_core shop cluster (`riak_a@{host}`, `riak_b@{host}`, `riak_c@{host}`) have got slow, and some time out. Find out why.

name: wishlist
prompt: In our riak_core shop (`riak_a@{host}`, `riak_b@{host}`), adding to a wishlist gets slower the longer the shop runs, and `riak_a`'s memory keeps growing. Find out why.

name: cowboy
prompt: Browsing products on `cowboy_ex@{host}` (GET http://localhost:8090/products) takes several seconds, though the products handler just returns a constant. Find out why.

name: yaws
prompt: The memory of `yaws_ex@{host}`, a Yaws API, keeps growing, though its traffic is steady. Find out why.

name: shackle
prompt: On `shackle_ex@{host}`, price lookups (`price_api:lookup/1`) fail now and then, though the pricing backend answers a lookup in a millisecond. Find out why.

name: telemetry
prompt: Checkout on `telemetry_ex@{host}` (`Shop.Checkout.run/1`) gets slower the longer the shop runs, and its CPU use creeps up. Find out why.

name: mnesia
prompt: Placing an order on `mnesia_erl@{host}` (`mnesia_shop:place_order/2`) takes up to a second at busy times, though an order's work takes about 30 ms. Find out why.

name: postgrex
prompt: Product pages on `postgrex_ex@{host}` (`Shop.Catalog.show/1`) are slow now and then, and some fail with "connection not available and request was dropped from queue", though their query takes a millisecond. Find out why.

name: tuning
prompt: Quotes for big orders on `tuning_erl@{host}` take about a second each (`quote:build/1`, e.g. `quote:build(quote:sample_order(3000))`). Profile it, find what to change, and measure. Don't load new code.

name: emqx
prompt: Our dashboard (MQTT client `dashboard-1`) misses sensor readings, and device `sensor-7` keeps going offline. EMQX is `emqx@127.0.0.1`. Find out why.

name: ejabberd
prompt: Order notifications to our logger bot, slowbot@localhost, arrive late or not at all, and ejabberd's memory keeps growing. Messages to support@localhost go missing too. ejabberd is `ejabberd@localhost`. Find out why.

name: ranch
prompt: New tills can't connect to our point-of-sale server, `ranch_ex@{host}` (port 5555): they time out, while the tills already connected keep working. Restarting it helps for a minute or so. Find out why.

name: live
prompt: The staff's orders dashboard, a LiveView on `live_ex@{host}` (http://localhost:4050/), gets sluggish the longer it's open, and the node's memory keeps growing. Find out why.

name: container
prompt: Our pricing service runs in a container, as svc@127.0.0.1 (cookie containerdemo). Every few seconds it stalls for up to 100 ms, though its CPU use looks moderate, and it was OOM-killed twice this week. Find out why.

name: inventory
prompt: Reservations on our inventory service, inventory_erl@{host}, sometimes take a third of a second, though a reservation is a map update; its mailbox never looks long. Find out why.

name: rabbitmq
prompt: Our order services hang when they publish to RabbitMQ, for minutes at a time, though the order worker is running. RabbitMQ is `rabbit@localhost`. Find out why.

name: sockets
prompt: Quotes from our quotes service, quotes@127.0.0.1 (in a container, cookie socketsdemo), take 40 ms each, though the pricing backend answers in microseconds; the node's memory keeps growing, and the nightly price export never finishes. Find out why.
